name: EAA P-014 leg (a), R-43: an app on another network (a GCP VM) runs the allowlisted general MCP tool work_items:list on a Papercusp-hosted workspace through the portal with a limited OAuth-minted app key and gets its result (live, 2026-10-01)

assertions.evidence: P014_OK the hosted machine minted an app key over the relay (scope: tool:blueprint:submit tool:blueprint:status tool:work_items:list harness:p014a-061030), after MCP OAuth consent on the portal by the owner
P014_OK tools/list lists the granted blueprint tools; P014_OK tools/list also lists the granted general tool work_items:list

P014_OK the app on another network ran the allowlisted general tool work_items:list on the hosted workspace through the portal and got its result: HTTP 200, no tool error, the result lists WI-5 (the work item the same app's blueprint:submit created moments earlier). vm-general-tool.txt
P014_OK a tool outside the consented scope is refused (plans:list): authorization_denied app_scope:tool_not_in_scope. vm-outside-scope.txt

All 20 P014_OK assertions of the leg (a) script passed, including no-key/bad-key 401, MCP OAuth discovery, consent, single-use code, blueprint submit + replay + status through the portal; 0 P014_FAIL, 0 retries.

rig.log: .papercusp/scratch/eaa/p014/a2-r43-3.log (20 P014_OK, 0 P014_FAIL, A2_SCRIPT_EXIT=0); per-step bodies in .papercusp/scratch/eaa/p014/a2-r43-3/ (access tokens redacted at capture)
rig.script: .papercusp/scratch/eaa/p014/a2r43-hosted.sh = a2-hosted.sh (the R-31 run) with tool:work_items:list added to the requested scope, a work_items:list call that must answer, and plans:list as the out-of-scope probe
rig.appClient: GCP VM pc-host-560adc2a196edd88206fb582-190a4acd-vm, public address 34.70.0.169: a different network from both the portal and the hosted machine

earlierRuns: r43-1 (06:02Z) and r43-2 (06:05Z) also passed the R-43 assertions (work_items:list answered through the portal, plans:list refused) but each failed one auxiliary tools/list check: r43-1 because the harness cut the response body to 4000 characters and work_items:list's long description pushed blueprint:submit past the cut; r43-2 because the VM's tools/list call hit a 90 s connection timeout to the portal that the retry helper did not retry. Both harness defects were fixed (body cap 60000; retry on a curl transport failure) before r43-3.

R-43.observed: From a GCP VM on another network, an app that obtained a limited key through MCP OAuth consent on the portal (scope: blueprint:submit, blueprint:status, work_items:list, one harness) called the general tool work_items:list on the hosted workspace through https://app.papercusp.com/api/workspaces/ws-2802cefffb052f989eae2969/mcp and got its result (it lists WI-5). The same key was refused plans:list, which it was not granted.

summary: Live P-014 leg (a) R-43 run 3 on the hosted workspace; 20 assertions passed, 0 failed.
